name: How much should I budget for luxury home design in Los Angeles if I want full-service design and furnishing?

mainEntity.name: How much does full-service luxury home design cost in Los Angeles for a custom home or major renovation?
mainEntity.text: How much does full-service luxury home design cost in Los Angeles for a custom home or major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a luxury home in Los Angeles, the design budget is often a major line item, not an afterthought. Full-service interior design can range from consultation-based fees to a comprehensive package that includes space planning, finish selections, custom cabinetry, furniture procurement, styling, and construction coordination. For larger homes or estates, the design and furnishing budget can easily move into the low six figures and beyond. The final number depends on square footage, level of customization, whether the home is new construction or a remodel, and how much sourcing and installation support is included. Buyers should ask whether the proposal covers concept development, renderings, specifications, purchasing, receiving, storage, and installation. A true luxury budget also needs contingency room for changes during construction, backordered items, and upgrades once work begins. Comparing bids only by hourly rate usually gives a misleading picture, because full-service designers differ greatly in scope and procurement responsibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Full-service luxury home design in Los Angeles often requires a separate design budget beyond construction, commonly ranging from six figures to several hundred thousand dollars depending on scope. Costs increase with custom millwork, imported finishes, sourcing, furnishings, and project management. A realistic budget should include design fees, FF&E, and a contingency for revisions.
